case: shadowed-search_path enum-leaf metadata and writes through nine nested domains
contract: The shared native contract runs domain-over-enum chains at depths six, seven, eight and nine while session search_path resolves a same-named shadow enum.
For each depth, catalog enum-leaf metadata drives a schema-aware keyed update and draft inserts for a label and SQL NULL.
Typed equality filtering returns the updated target-schema row; invalid-label assignment is refused with SQLSTATE 22P02.

On the same transaction backend, search_path changes first to the target then to the shadow schema. Metadata fetched before the changes still drives keyed and draft writes, typed filtering and exact native type/value checks.
The transaction verifies SQL NULL and rolls back after invalid-label refusal; native rows after rollback match the pre-transaction snapshot at depths six through nine.
